segments: Routing, robot and snow timing, staff dupes, and skips for a fast Black Ops III Origins run, built from the advanced route in the linked walkthrough. Puzzle solutions stay on the staff tabs.
Arrow = where the rounded inner end points.
The flat handle sticks out of the ring on the opposite side.
The seven switches can be pre-set before the Lightning Staff piano step. Once that upgrade step is active, a correctly positioned switch stops sparking.
Set this immediately at the start of the run; the advanced route turns it while leaving spawn.
Set it while clearing Tank Station for the Ice disc / G-Strike tablet route.
Set it on the Gen 5 pass so the later Lightning upgrade does not cost an extra detour.
Set it when routing through Gen 4 for Wind / Lightning progression.
Set the lower-church dial while passing through the tank area.
The advanced route handles this during the church setup before leaving the area.
Finish this on a mound pass; it is the seventh required dial.
Turn counts assume the switch is still in its untouched match-start position. If you already interacted with it, ignore the count and use the final arrow.
Optional advanced first-piece route that uses movement and death-barrier timing instead of the tank or Boomhilda.
Set max FPS below 110; the demonstrated setup uses about 100 FPS and notes that lower values can make the movement easier.
Run straight at the wall near the first Lightning-piece area. Near the corner, jump and hold the movement input to climb onto the edge.
Aim roughly toward the wooden platform and hold forward briefly along the edge.
Face the final wall, run, and jump as late as possible to get onto the piece area.

Use a consistent timer reference for the death barrier. In the demonstrated setup, checks repeat on roughly three-second intervals; begin the final run just before the next check to maximize the safe window.
Reach the wooden stairs before the following check and favor the left side, where the death barrier disables sooner.
Grab the Lightning Staff piece and rejoin the normal route.
Practice this separately before using it in a run. If the timing is inconsistent, use the normal tank route or the Boomhilda skip instead.
